boundaries: Record integrity is technical evidence, not scientific, human, provider or learner acceptance.
Native scoped/parsed digests are not raw file hashes. Declared raw paths require exact current, historical or explicitly recovered bytes.
Earlier records and unchanged raw reviewer answers keep their exact bytes and explicit concrete successors.
Absolute operational paths are rendered using supplied root aliases; no account directories or correspondence contents are published.
The inventory is developed against the live worktree and must be refreshed after native activation, final documentation and the integration commit.
Local Python bytecode is recorded as a transient derivative, never silently omitted or promoted as a source.
